name: Grammar — the meta implementation (codex Parts II+III made executable)
round: Grammar · the meta implementation — decoder (D1) + compiler (C1) + corruption taxonomy (C2.8), judged by the step mode
criteria_source: The criteria are quoted from rounds/meta-implementation/commission.md §2 (staged on the box 2026-08-29, sha c9f3fda1270d440a3cf3fb6bf1b13fcc95ee75da4b54f9a66b7095404c5553ee), which quotes the held Codex (§2.1-2.5, §2.8, §3.1-3.6) and Appendix D (§D.7/D.8/D.12/D.14). The held sources are the Codex (page sha ccad26dd..., extraction e5f0c738...) and Appendix D (page sha a49e9413..., extraction 6bb28c37...).

criteria.title: the Decoder — the numbered decoding operation walked symbol-by-symbol, in order, over the adaptive context, fail closed
criteria.verbatim: C1 — The Decoder. §2.1–2.5, the five decoding operations, symbol-by-symbol, over the adaptive context (§2.6 / §3.3). §3.5 (syntax): "Every decoding operation follows D1 symbol-by-symbol"; §3.5 (drift): "No decoding step omitted or reordered." §2.9: "The decoding operations do not change at scale."

criteria.title: the Compiler — the constitutional block byte-for-byte, the five compiled phases, the context chain verbatim
criteria.verbatim: C2 — The Compiler. §3.1 "Every compiled surface carries this block exactly". §3.2 the five compiled phases each with EQUATION / OUTPUT / CONTEXT IN / CONTEXT OUT / DECODING / CORRUPTION / LENSES. §3.3 the adaptive context chain: S with ∅ (or ∞0' from prior cycle) → X … V with full trace → B + B'' + ∞0'.

criteria.title: the thirteen decoder rules, checkable — R1–R13 enforced with verbatim citations
criteria.verbatim: C3 — The thirteen decoder rules, checkable. §3.4 R1–R13, enforced as checks: R1 … R13 (verbatim citations, the source's own numbering).

criteria.title: the corruption taxonomy — exactly five, each a named decoding failure, no sixth
criteria.verbatim: C4 — Corruption taxonomy. §2.8, exactly five, each a named decoding failure: L1 Closing · L2 Generating · L3 Claiming · L4 Performing · V∅ Incomplete. §3.5 (syntax): "Five corruption codes exactly"; §3.5 (drift): "No corruption code added beyond five."

criteria.title: the validation protocol — syntax/semantic/drift (§3.5) + D.12 + R1–R13 + HC, applied to any surface
criteria.verbatim: C5 — Validation protocol. §3.5, all three passes applied to any produced surface — syntax (6), semantic (6), drift (6) — with "B, B'', ∞0' are three distinct things with distinct decoding steps" and "Crystallization reads the formation trail (not generated from nothing)."

criteria.title: surface emission + the addressing layer — block exact, lawful parse, jacket visibly separate, 4+1 / signless start / ∞0′≡∞0
criteria.verbatim: C6 — Surface emission + the addressing layer. §3.6 "Every emitted surface must carry: Constitutional block (§3.1) — exact · The active phase's compiled form WITH decoding operation (§3.2) · The adaptive context chain (§3.3) · The decoder rules (§3.4) · Resolved symbols for every symbol used (§1.9)" — and "Surfaces may add behavioral, interface, and domain layers — visibly separate from the decoding." Appendix D.12: 4+1 invariant, five equations verbatim, signless true start (AR5), ∞0′ ≡ ∞0 (D.8).

criteria.title: the authenticity prohibition — HC-1/HC-2 permanently INCONCLUSIVE, no authenticity field, a claim to reach ∞0 reads L3 never arrival
criteria.verbatim: C7 — The authenticity prohibition (the load-bearing refusal). The engine never scores, decides, or asserts authenticity. HC-1 ("a machine click is never a verdict") and HC-2 are permanently INCONCLUSIVE. No write path to state:attested; no non-null attestation_ref; a decode that claims to have reached ∞0 is corruption L3, reported as such — never as arrival.

claims.title: stdlib-only, deterministic, no LLM in the engine mechanics
claims.verbatim: Stdlib only, deterministic, no LLM in the engine mechanics (the LLM lives at the desk, never in the decoder/compiler).

claims.title: the equation byte forms enumerated with source + sha, never normalised
claims.verbatim: No byte normalisation (⋂→∩ is renaming). The enumerated ∞0′/∞0' and ∩/⋂ forms are accepted as data, never folded into one.

claims.title: D14 loyalty + the divergence log — no new L1 symbol, decoding operation, or sixth corruption code
claims.verbatim: Every decoding and compiling loyal to 5qln.com/codex (D14). Anything added beyond the source is declared derivative, visibly separate, no new L1 symbol, no new decoding operation, no sixth corruption code.

claims.title: no authenticity verdict — the engine never writes state:attested, never sets a machine attestation_ref
claims.verbatim: No authenticity verdict. The run has no write path to state attested and never types the human's word.

claims.title: no write path to the podium — no question.md write, no cell-attest, no input()
claims.verbatim: No write path to the podium (PRD §2.1, T-R3-02). The engine never writes nodes/*/question.md, never invokes cell-attest, never prompts the centre S.
